phases.title: Discover
phases.text: AI maturity assessment, stakeholder interviews, data landscape review, and use case prioritisation across your enterprise.
phases.deliverable: AI Opportunity Map + Prioritised Use Case Backlog

phases.title: Design
phases.text: Technical architecture, technology selection, security framework, team structure, and a sprint-by-sprint 12-week build plan.

phases.title: Deploy
phases.text: FDE engineers embedded and shipping — AI features, agents, and infrastructure built, tested, and deployed into your production environment.
phases.deliverable: Live AI Systems + Integration Test Reports

phases.title: Scale
phases.text: Performance monitoring, model optimisation, new use cases, and structured knowledge transfer to your internal team.
